notes: Checked: offsets/quotes match text; approved_output reproduced exactly by applying decisions. Alias of Aigerim Bekova with 'My sister,' kept is correct; negation, uncertainty ('3 days, no wait, 4'), dose and units preserved; output matches my blind expectation. Defect: over-annotation.
